meta.description: Tier 2 truth set (validation only, tolerance +-0.15 ppm, exchangeable protons +-0.5). Values and source labels are the planner (user) list of 2026-11-09: part A = SDBS / ChemicalBook / RSC SI values looked up by the user; part B = Hans Reich NMR collection (organicchemistrydata.org). Only numbers and source labels are stored (no images, no text copied). SMILES and SMARTS were written by the executor.
meta.reichNote: Reich values were read by hand from structure figures, not copied from text; most carry no solvent (stored as "unspecified").

grades.A: user-looked-up measured value (SDBS / ChemicalBook / RSC SI), CDCl3
grades.T1g: user states the value is of tier-1 quality (RSC SI measured, independently agrees with Reich / Pretsch; Chem. Sci. 2020 SI)

meta.alternatives: a signal whose ppm is an array has two literature sets; the error is the smaller one
duplicatesOfTier1NotStored: propionic acid COOH (kept once, from the A list)

round2.description: Stop 13: second batch of truth values from the planner list of 2026-11-10 (parts A-G; part H in benzeneIncrements). Entries carry round: 2. Journal values carry candidate: true (grade J). Calibration rule of the stop: tier-2 and candidate data may calibrate a class only with >= 3 independent compounds, leave-one-out validation and a lower mean error; exchangeable protons only widen the tolerance (+-0.5).
round2.rangeOnly: a signal with rangeOnly: true has error 0 inside [range] and the distance to the nearest end outside
round2.exchangeable: OH / SH / NH / COOH: tolerance +-0.5, never a calibration point
